system.flavor: 40mm squash-head round, WA -1. Direct hit; armor has no effect and loses 5 SP.
system.notes:
THE BOOK: Home of the Brave p.86, "HEP: A 40mm version of the 25mm HEP, it is WA -1, does 7D6 damage (half goes through, half is concussion), and armor is reduced by 5 SP."

MODEL: armor has no effect, as for the 25mm HEP it is a version of; the half-is-concussion and the 5 SP armor loss are by hand.

MODEL: the round has no blast radius of its own, so blastRadius is 0.5 m - the module's area flow then reaches the target's own square and nothing beyond it (a 0 would fall back to the 5 m grenade row of CP2020 p.99).
